**Fix:** commit `0e06523b799319ec65716df66eafb32aef170b3c`, "(fix) O3-6100: Prevent duplicate vitals saves (#3792)", by Dennis Kigen, 2026-10-13.

**Line changed:** `packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/exported-vitals-biometrics-form.workspace.tsx:225`. The commit adds `return` in front of `createOrUpdateVitalsAndBiometrics(...)`. The diff has only that one hunk. Before the fix, the save promise was not returned to `handleSubmit`, so react-hook-form saw the submit as finished and `isSubmitting` went false while the request was still pending. The Save button's `disabled={!hasUserUnsavedChanges || isSubmitting}` at line 677 then re-enabled, and a second click could save again. Returning the promise keeps `isSubmitting` true until the request settles.

**Regression coverage:** the same commit adds the test "saves only once when Save and close is double-clicked while the request is pending". It also adds a test for retrying a failed save without losing the entered measurements. Both are in `vitals-biometrics-form.test.tsx`.

The local checkout already contains the fix. Falkon's `grep` found no text match for "O3-6100" in the repository contents, so I located the fix through the commit history for the form directory.

Evidence, best first:

- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/exported-vitals-biometrics-form.workspace.tsx:225` (the fixed line)
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/exported-vitals-biometrics-form.workspace.tsx:673-681` (Save button, disabled while `isSubmitting`)
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-vitals-app/src/vitals-biometrics-form/vitals-biometrics-form.test.tsx:298-328` (double-click regression test)
